sources.title: The visions that shaped us: Nokia Design Archive opens to the public online

claims.text: The Nokia version of Snake was launched on the Nokia 6110.
Taneli Armanto, a Nokia design engineer, programmed Snake into a Nokia device in 1997.
Snake-like games existed on earlier computers and calculators before Nokia's 1997 phone implementation.
Snake was part of the everyday mobile-phone experience associated with Nokia's 1990s and early-2000s era.

abstentions.question: What programming language was used for the original 1997 Nokia implementation?
abstentions.reason: The reviewed authoritative sources do not establish the implementation language. SMART OS must research further rather than guess.
